import urllib.request, json

# 1. Auth as owner
auth_req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login",
    data=json.dumps({"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}).encode(),
    headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST"
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(auth_req, timeout=30) as resp:
    token = json.loads(resp.read()).get("accessToken","")

# 2. GitHub HEAD SHA
gh_req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action",
    data=json.dumps({"action":"github_get_repo_head","input":{"branch":"main"}}).encode(),
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST"
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(gh_req, timeout=30) as resp:
    d = json.loads(resp.read())
    r = d.get("result", d)
    GH_SHA = r.get("headSha","")

# 3. Render production SHA
render_req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action",
    data=json.dumps({"action":"render_get_deploy_status","input":{}}).encode(),
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    method="POST"
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(render_req, timeout=30) as resp:
    d = json.loads(resp.read())
    r = d.get("result", d)
    RENDER_SHA = ""
    for entry in r.get("data", []):
        dep = entry.get("deploy", {})
        if dep.get("status") == "live":
            RENDER_SHA = dep.get("commit", {}).get("id", "")
            break

# 4. Runtime SHA
with urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.ivxholding.com/health", timeout=30) as resp:
    RUNTIME_SHA = json.loads(resp.read()).get("commit", "")

# 5. Compare
print(f"GitHub HEAD SHA: {GH_SHA}")
print(f"Render SHA: {RENDER_SHA}")
print(f"Runtime SHA: {RUNTIME_SHA}")
if GH_SHA and RENDER_SHA and RUNTIME_SHA and GH_SHA == RENDER_SHA == RUNTIME_SHA:
    print("SHA Match: YES")
else:
    print("SHA Match: NO")
    if GH_SHA != RENDER_SHA:
        print(f"  Mismatch: GitHub ({GH_SHA}) != Render ({RENDER_SHA})")
    if GH_SHA != RUNTIME_SHA:
        print(f"  Mismatch: GitHub ({GH_SHA}) != Runtime ({RUNTIME_SHA})")
    if RENDER_SHA != RUNTIME_SHA:
        print(f"  Mismatch: Render ({RENDER_SHA}) != Runtime ({RUNTIME_SHA})")
PYEOF
